name: Eguchi Kanoko
source:
Eguchi family's second daughter. The biggest crybaby and mama's girl among the sisters. Her innocent and carefree personality makes her the mood maker of the Eguchi household in a way.

At work, she's always making blunders and gets scolded by the head nurse for “lacking a spirit of service.” She seems particularly uncomfortable with male pubic hair removal.

"Waku-chan, I'm sorry... I did something unbecoming of an older sister again..."

Noko-nee is a clumsy new nurse. But when she summons her spirit of service, she unleashes genius-level blowjob skills!

Her specialty move is the Super Vacuum Blowjob! she licks and sucks every inch of the shaft, then sucks right from the tip with a satisfying “suck!”
